name: @pipeworx/mcp-wmata

tools.name: rail_lines
tools.description: Return all WMATA Metro rail lines (Red, Blue, Orange, Silver, Green, Yellow) with line code, display name, start/end station codes, and internal track IDs.

tools.name: rail_stations
tools.description: Return all WMATA Metro rail stations, optionally filtered by `line_code`. Returns station code, name, line codes served, and latitude/longitude.

tools.name: rail_station_info
tools.description: Fetch details for a specific WMATA Metro station by `station_code`. Returns name, address, line codes, adjacent station codes, and coordinates.

tools.name: rail_predictions
tools.description: Fetch real-time next-train arrival predictions for one or more WMATA stations by comma-separated `station_codes` (or "All"). Returns line, destination, car count, and minutes until arrival.

tools.name: rail_incidents
tools.description: Fetch current WMATA Metro rail service alerts and incidents. Returns incident description, affected line codes, date/time updated, and incident type.

tools.name: bus_routes
tools.description: Return all WMATA bus routes. Returns route ID, route name, and line description. Use to enumerate available routes before fetching details or predictions.

tools.name: bus_route_details
tools.description: Fetch stop sequence and path details for a WMATA bus route by `route_id` and optional `date`. Returns direction names, stop names/IDs, and geo coordinates for the route shape.

tools.name: bus_stops
tools.description: Find WMATA bus stops near a latitude/longitude within an optional `radius` (meters). Returns stop ID, name, routes serving the stop, and coordinates.

tools.name: bus_predictions
tools.description: Fetch real-time next-bus arrival predictions for a WMATA bus stop by `stop_id`. Returns route ID, direction text, vehicle ID, and minutes until arrival.

tools.name: bus_incidents
tools.description: Fetch current WMATA bus service alerts and incidents. Returns incident description, affected route IDs, date/time updated, and incident type.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wmata forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wmata pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
